# MCP writes, previews and jobs

Current data contract data/3. Discover the instance's actual tools with api_operations_list, api_contract_get and api_examples_get. Contracts do not expand consent.

Record uses Collection-scoped document actions; Sample append uses items under a URL-scoped parent Record. Use /uns/records:transact with dryRun for mixed business steps, checks, reads, dependencies and result bindings. Use dedicated metadata tools or uns_meta_batch_validate / uns_meta_batch for configuration.

Optional idempotencyKey. All metadata expectedRevision fields are optional; supplied revisions must match. Stream immutable history remains. Record document filters share the query predicate grammar; single actions select the first sorted match and return zero counts when unmatched. Combine identity and business conditions in that filter; expectedRevision is an optional additional guard. Creation id and Sample append recordId are identities, not query selectors. Record many/bulk default to per-document writes with ordered=true and atomic=false; atomic:true supports up to 200 items. insertedIds/upsertedIds map original zero-based input indexes to IDs. Metadata insertMany/updateMany/deleteMany/restore are atomic; bulkWrite defaults to atomic:true and can explicitly use atomic:false with results/errors. metadata:transact remains atomic. Resource dryRun=true previews; Record and metadata:transact both use dryRun. See the [complete write contract](tier0://mcp/skill-docs/doc/openapi-v2.md).

Scopes and real permissions intersect on every item: uns.read, uns.write, uns.model.manage, uns.source.manage, uns.stream.manage and uns.app.manage. Deletion additionally needs uns.delete and the relevant write consent. App keys also require current Collection grants. Credentials, App members/roles and key issuance retain their dedicated boundaries. Existing read-only grants gain no writes automatically.

Reads, transaction results and job results retain credential redaction and JSON number precision. Bindings cannot rename sensitive credential paths to evade redaction. Never write [REDACTED] back. Metadata patches preserve omitted fields under the transaction lock.

Accepted responses return jobId; use uns_jobs_query and paginate resultOffset/resultSize until hasMoreResults=false. Job access checks owner and current permissions. Atomic sync keyless writes create no retry receipt; partial writes always retain jobId and per-item recovery receipts. Failed partial jobs still expose result.summary/results: never infer whole-request rollback from job.status. Without an idempotency key, identical submissions are separate operations: inspect business state or the returned job after a timeout, never automatically retry an increment or append.

Duplicate legacy data routes have been removed; use the current operation catalog. Saving Source/Stream configuration does not prove deployment or ingestion; follow the [Source/Stream Skill](tier0://mcp/skills/tier0-source-stream).
